title: introduce-concurrent-rag-playbook-collab-watcher
author: Sana Park
description: Motivation: fast feedback loops for RAG authoring often come from single-developer workflows. This quickstart introduces a collaborative authoring mode and a lightweight 'collab-watcher' daemon that streams authoring events and telemetry to the local dev console, enabling simultaneous editing and live validation of prompt variants across a small team. The goal is to provide a developer-friendly pattern showing how to: 1) run a hosted-ish local playbook server to coordinate session state, 2) connect multiple authoring clients (browser/CLI) to the same RAG playbook, 3) use the watcher to emit compact telemetry (prompt diffs, embedding hits, retrieval latencies) to the Redwood Console simulator, and 4) demonstrate a safe minimal policy for shared tool-calling in authoring sessions. This PR adds: a new quickstart directory (concurrent-collab-watcher), a compact dev server (Node, no DB) with in-memory session syncing, a browser-based authoring UI example (React) wired to the Redwood JS SDK sample, instructions for using the watcher binary to stream telemetry into the existing local telemetry-proxy, and docs site updates to add a new quickstart page with step-by-step onboarding. Checklist: - [x] implement in-memory playbook sync server and watcher - [x] add React authoring demo with multi-client test harness - [x] sample scripts for starting watcher and proxy - [x] docs page and quickstart readme with screenshots and commands - [x] minimal E2E smoke script used in CI - [x] add telemetry presets to telemetry-probes example Notes on scope: this is intentionally lightweight and not intended for production clustering. The server is a dev helper focused on authoring ergonomics and debugging (session export/import included). Related: references ENG-1029 (playbook UX improvements) and the local telemetry proxy quickstart.

release_notes: Added 'Concurrent RAG Playbook — Collab Watcher' quickstart: a local multi-author playbook demo with a small watcher that streams compact telemetry to the local proxy. Intended for developer authoring workflows and debugging. Not for production use. Includes sample scripts and an e2e smoke job.
notes_for_maintainers: This quickstart introduces a short-lived binary (watcher/main.go) and a small node dev server. Both are intentionally minimal; if we ever accept productionization, follow-up work should add persistence and auth. The telemetry format is versioned (telemetry-presets.json v1) so future changes should bump the schema version and maintain backward compatibility in the local proxy. If port collisions appear in CI, increase ephemeral port backoff in ci/jobs/quickstarts-smoke.yml.
